FAQ.TITLE: FAQ
FAQ.A1: As a rule, I need about 1 to 2 weeks lead time for a clean onboarding. However, if your critical systems fail (keyword: Technical Rescue or live bugs), I can also free up capacity for an emergency sprint at short notice by arrangement.
FAQ.A2: No blind flight, no micromanagement. We always start with a clearly defined scope. After that, I develop in iterative sprints. For you, this means: regular, transparent updates, fixed check-ins, and measurable milestones. You know exactly where the project stands at all times.
FAQ.Q3: Are there fixed project prices or retainers?
FAQ.A3: For clearly defined projects with a fixed scope, I offer fixed project prices. For ongoing support, complex refactorings, or multi-store setups, I usually work with a retainer or sprint model.
FAQ.A4: No. Core expertise: modern frontend engineering (JavaScript, TypeScript, React). In addition to Shopify, I also develop configurators, interactive UI components, and high-performance web apps.
FAQ.Q5: Do you also take over existing 'chaos projects'?
FAQ.A5: Absolutely. Technical Rescue is one of my specialties: analyze bottlenecks, refactor architecture, and bring the project cleanly across the finish line.
FAQ.Q6: Do you also work white-label for agencies?
FAQ.A6: Yes. I regularly support agencies (e.g., Shopify Platinum Partners) with bottlenecks or enterprise features – seamlessly integrated into existing GitHub and CI/CD processes.

AI_POLICY.TITLE: AI Policy
AI_POLICY.P1: This policy describes how I use AI-assisted tools in my workflow to support the creation of concepts, texts, designs, and code.
AI_POLICY.S1_P1: AI-based systems are used by me exclusively as assistant tools for brainstorming, analysis, structuring, and general efficiency increase. There is explicitly no automated decision-making.
AI_POLICY.S1_P2: The final review, evaluation, and approval of all content, concepts, and technical implementations is always carried out by me personally as the responsible Director.
AI_POLICY.S2_P1: Only data that is strictly necessary for the respective task is used for AI-assisted processes. Personal, confidential, or security-critical customer data (such as API keys, sensitive database dumps, or trade secrets) are under no circumstances entered into public or uncontrollable AI systems.
AI_POLICY.S3_P1: Every AI-generated or -assisted content is professionally reviewed, manually revised, and evaluated for technical accuracy, clarity, consistency, and compliance with the defined project goals before it is implemented or delivered to the customer.
AI_POLICY.S4_P1: I attach great importance to open communication. On request, I will transparently provide information about the nature and extent of AI use within a specific customer project at any time.
AI_POLICY.S5_P1: If you have questions about the use of Artificial Intelligence in our collaboration, you can contact me directly via this link at any time.
